prompt: Task: extract full text of Gmail messages to a file. Read the JSON list of Gmail message ids in /tmp/ids_part0.json (mailbox robert@harmonygames.co). For every id, fetch the message with the tool mcp__hg__gmail_get_messages_batch (user_email "me", format "full", at most 10 ids per call — that is the hard limit). When a tool result is too large it is saved to a file whose path is reported; read/parse that file with python3 (no jq available). Append records as JSON lines to /tmp/mail_part0.jsonl. Process ALL ids; do not skip any; do not summarize content. When done, verify the line count of /tmp/mail_part0.jsonl equals the number of ids (dedupe by id), and report the count and any ids that failed. Do not send emails or modify anything.
